transcript: Speaker A: Just got back from a co-working session and some of my friends are productivity bros. They were laughing at me because I was typing my emails. They showed me this app called Wispr Flow and it's an AI voice-to-text generator. Watch this. 'Hey Daniel, great chatting with you over lunch. Let's meet again on Thursday, actually Friday at 1:30, uh make that 2:30. Best regards, Dominic.' I just misspoke twice and Wispr Flow only dictated the actual sentence that I wanted to send. I'm so excited about this because I'm literally doubling my outreach. I can speak three to four times faster than I can type, which means I'm going to land more clients and make more money. The cherry on top is that Wispr is literally free to try.
on_screen_text: Why are you still typing when speaking is 4x faster?
summary: A presenter demonstrates Wispr Flow, an AI voice-to-text tool that filters out speech mistakes to draft clean emails instantly. He explains how speaking instead of typing increases his productivity and outreach speed. The ad concludes by noting that the tool is free to try.
